# Contributing to hotchpotch

This outlines how to propose a change to hotchpotch.

## Fixing typos

You can fix typos, spelling mistakes, or grammatical errors in the documentation directly using the GitHub web interface, as long as the changes are made in the _source_ file. 

## Bigger changes

If you want to make a bigger change, it's a good idea to first file an issue and make sure someone from the team agrees that it’s needed. 

### Pull request process

*   Fork the package and clone onto your computer. If you haven't done this before, we recommend using `usethis::create_from_github("anu-aagi/hotchpotch", fork = TRUE)`.

## Code of Conduct

Please note that the hotchpotch project is released with a
[Contributor Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). By contributing to this
project you agree to abide by its terms.
